sources_considered.why: Anthropic's filed S-1. The live SEC page refused the automated read (HTTP 403), so the Internet Archive copy from October 2026 was used.
Announces the filing (dated October 26, 2026) but gives no figures.

evidence_items.publisher: Anthropic, PBC (Form S-1, filed with the SEC)
evidence_items.locator: Consolidated Statements of Operations, page F-7; columns are 2023, 2024, 2025 (in millions of USD)
evidence_items.explanation: The S-1 reports a 2025 operating loss of $8,060 million and, on the same page, a net loss of $41,965 million. The operating loss is consistent with 'over $8 billion', but Zitron did not say he meant operating loss, so this is shown as context and does not decide an outcome.

unresolved_gaps: The claim names no loss measure, so no figure in the S-1 can be matched to it without our choosing one.
